body.intent: Fix Plan interviews duplicate decisions: when the planner already wrote Decisions for the owner's answers, session done still auto-creates answer-<session>-N Decisions from the same AskUserQuestion picks (seen in plan run 01M6FY99J90TC3RGT2ZCDXFNR5: seven duplicates), with default owner wording even when the answers came from a proxy. session done should skip picks a Decision in the change set already answers (or link to it), and the planner guide should say which side records them. Also each rhiza apply write takes ~6 s on the VM (31 writes > 3 min); see the daemon CPU bug
